parts.label: (b)(ii)
(c)
parts.stem:
**Y** is a structural isomer of **W**.

Both **W** and **Y** produce colourless bubbles when sodium is added to them.

**Y** does **not** react when heated with acidified $\text{K}_2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7$.

**Y** does **not** react when warmed with alkaline $\text{I}_2\text{(aq)}$.

parts.text: Name the functional group present in **Y**.
